sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Jitendra Pal Singh Chauhan

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

This writ petition has been filed seeking the following among other relief:-
"i) issue a writ, order or direction in nature of mandamus commanding/ directing the respondent nos. 2 and 3 District Magistrate, Muzaffarnagar & Designated Officer,
Food Safety & Drug Administration, District Muzaffarnagar respectively
for speedy disposal of claim of the petitioner regarding license for opening of meat shop under Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 pending since 26.6.2020

. "
It is stated that on the application of the petitioner for a licence to seen a meat shop, no objection certificate has been granted by the Gram Panchayat and SHO.
Yet the license has not been issued to the petitioner for running the meat shop.

In this regard, a representation dated 26.02.2020 has also Asif vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102518583/
1 been made, which is pending consideration.

entities.text: Asif vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, without entering into the merits of the controversy between the parties, we dispose of the writ petition with a direction to the authority concerned to consider and decide the representation filed by the petitioner expeditiously, preferably within a period of two months from the date of production of a copy of this order before him.
Order Date :- 18.12.2020 Priyanka  Asif vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 December, 2020
